Schnittstelle Seq<A>

Typparameter:
A - the element type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Container<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Seq.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Seq.µ>, Iterable<A>, Streamable<A>, Supplier<A>, Value<A>
public interface Seq<A> extends Container<A>, Value<A>, Streamable<A>, Iterable<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Seq.µ,A>

A sequence of values of type A. A sequence may be empty, contain one or more elements, and can be extended by adding elements or concatenating other sequences.

Unless stated otherwise by a concrete implementation, elements are treated in encounter order, operations are expected to be null‑safe (no null elements), and methods return non‑null results. Implementations should document strictness (eager vs. lazy), mutability, and complexity characteristics.

1.0.0

    • cons

      @NonNull Seq<A> cons(@NonNull A element)

    • toCollection

      <C extends Collection<? super A>> @NonNull C toCollection(@NonNull Supplier<C> init)

      Materializes this sequence into a concrete Collection provided by the supplier.

      Contract: init must not be null and must construct a fresh, mutable collection. Implementations must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      C - the concrete collection type
      Parameter:
      init - a supplier for the target collection instance; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a collection containing the elements of this sequence (never null)
